repairs.title: Restore daily maintenance recording
repairs.problem: GitHub reported successful scheduled runs that skipped the website inspection, leaving the last saved technical report on November 7.
repairs.fix: Removed the time cutoff that discarded late scans, added a backup scheduled attempt and retry, and recorded actual start and completion times.
repairs.verification: On November 11 a fresh GitHub Actions scan completed successfully and saved a dated result covering 124 pages, 142 links and 14 browser views. Verification covers report recording; a future delayed scheduled run still needs observation.

repairs.title: Late-running 4 AM schedule protection
repairs.problem: A delayed job previously exited without checking the site when it started outside the old 4–5 AM time window.
repairs.fix: Changed the scheduled-run gate to reject only early runs before 4 AM Central, added a later backup cron entry, and a one-time retry on errors.
repairs.verification: Code change is saved. Full verification requires observing a future delayed scheduled run instead of a push-triggered run.
